routes.question: Can triple codegrees force two disjoint 4-sets by a short local incidence argument?
premises: every triple has degree at least two
routes.method: link families, complements, shadows, and double counting
evidence: proof/main_proof.md gives a self-contained fixed-edge/link proof for every n>=9
proof/independent_crosscheck.md gives a distinct n=9 graph-counting proof

routes.question: Does an exact SAT/PB model admit a counterexample for n=9 or n=10?
routes.method: independent CNF/PB encodings with exact model verification
evidence: n=8 exact SAT family verifies delta_3=2
two independent encodings report UNSAT at n=9,10
canonical instances have externally verified LRAT certificates
routes.failure_reason: No endpoint counterexample exists; the canonical LRAT proofs derive the empty clause.
routes.next_test: retain n=8 as a sharp positive control

routes.question: Can UNSAT be bound to a standard proof trace checked independently?
routes.method: CaDiCaL proof trace plus a separate proof checker; hashes bind generator, CNF, trace, and output
evidence: freshly compiled pinned external lrat-check reports VERIFIED

routes.question: Can S_n symmetry and monotonicity reduce one endpoint to the other or shrink certificates without losing completeness?
routes.method: proved orbit/canonical augmentation only; no heuristic symmetry assumptions
evidence: naive deletion loses one unit of triple degree
direct proof separates n=9 from uniform n>=10 range
routes.failure_reason: Deletion only preserves minimum triple degree at least one, so no 10-to-9 induction closes the counterexample condition.
routes.next_test: none; direct structural proof is stronger

routes.question: Can an independent implementation reconstruct and reject malformed certificates from serialized inputs only?
routes.method: definition-first verifier, mutation tests, second encoding/evaluator, and referee reconstruction
evidence: definition-first CNF verifier accepts canonical instances and rejects five mutations
snapshot-based LRAT wrapper accepts two proofs and rejects eight bad traces
blind mathematical referee and certificate referee report no fatal or major defects
three isolated citation audits, second novelty pass, clean build, and four-page visual audit pass
routes.next_test: none; all required audit gates are closed
